text: A lever rotates about a fulcrum. Changing the positions of the pivot, effort, and load changes how force and travel are exchanged.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: An inclined plane spreads a rise in height over a longer path. A ramp lets the lifting task be performed with a smaller force over more distance.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A wedge turns force along its length into forces against its sloping sides, separating material or holding parts apart.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A screw wraps an inclined path around an axis. Turning it advances the thread through a matching surface.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13. Additional source: NASA Glenn, The Screw; https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12/Summer_Training/KaeAvenueES/The_Screw.html.

text: A fixed pulley redirects a rope's force, allowing a downward pull to lift a load.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A wheel and its axle rotate together; applying force at different radii exchanges force for motion.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A compound machine combines simple machines, such as a lever and a pulley, into a mechanism for a more specific task.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: NASA, STEMonstrations Simple Machines classroom guide; https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/simple-machines-classroom-connection-508.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Torque depends on force and the perpendicular distance from the rotation axis to the force's line of action. A long handle is useful only if the force is applied in a useful direction.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: OpenStax, University Physics Volume 1, section 10.6; https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/10-6-torque. Consulted 2026-10-13. OpenStax educational text is CC BY 4.0; this record is independently worded.

text: A force directed straight toward or away from a pivot produces no torque about that pivot, even if the force is large.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: OpenStax, University Physics Volume 1, section 10.6; https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/10-6-torque. Consulted 2026-10-13. OpenStax educational text is CC BY 4.0; this record is independently worded.
